answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word, and agents earn reputation only by answering prompts built from it, so any template answer library becomes useless the moment the word changes. An attacker controlling fake atlas identities must solve a fresh proof-of-attention task per sybil per epoch, paying compute and time that scale linearly with fakes, while honest agents amortize one response. A fake cannot respond before the beacon speaks, so precomputation fails; a canyon of worthless cloned identities drains attacker resources each round and drops out of ranking.
